### Imagination versus Inspiration
Author: Oswald Chambers
Site: My Utmost for His Highest
URL: https://utmost.org/modern-classic/imagination-versus-inspiration/
Passage: 2 Corinthians 11:3
Points:
- Simplicity is essential for perceiving God's will and maintaining spiritual clarity.
- Mental analysis cannot resolve spiritual confusion; clear sight comes only through prompt obedience.
- Allowing even small areas of life outside the Holy Spirit's control clouds discernment.
- Surrendering our imagination and thoughts to Christ preserves purity of heart and single-minded devotion.

### A Prayer of Sincere and Pure Devotion to Jesus
Author: Scotty Smith
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/blogs/scotty-smith/a-prayer-of-sincere-and-pure-devotion-to-jesus/
Passage: 2 Corinthians 11:1-3
Points:
- The church's primary identity is that of a cherished bride betrothed to Christ.
- Believers are defined by Jesus' love and sacrifice rather than external achievements or ministries.
- Satan seeks to derail believers from simple, wholehearted affection for the Savior through seduction or trial.
- Christ has already conquered Satan, guaranteeing believers' standing in His righteousness.
- Christians should pray for the Holy Spirit to rekindle their initial passion and devotion to Jesus.

### Fluffy Deception
Author: Lou Ann Prater
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-11-14-03-1230385.html
Passage: 2 Corinthians 11:3
Points:
- Temptation rarely looks dangerous upfront; it often presents itself as comfortable, peaceful, and harmless.
- The enemy exploits vulnerabilities by disguising traps as things we feel we deserve.
- Just as Eve was deceived by appealing fruit, believers can easily be misled by attractive falsehoods.
- Embracing deceptive compromise always results in spiritual turbulence and damage.
- Believers must continuously test desires and circumstances against God's unchanging truth.
